paragraphs: R' Yudan bar Yishmael. See the entry Rav Yehudah bar Yishmael.[^1]

notes.text: The heading abbreviates Yudan’s title, rendered R'; the target explicitly writes Rav Yehudah. The source dash before bar Yishmael is read as part of the connected target name, without an additional person. The distinct Yudan/Yehudah forms are retained.
